items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...we just stopped at George Gaynos... [INTERVIEWEE] I'll tell you, I'll tell you. Player of that, maybe.

ctx.x: A lot of people have told me how wonderful you were on banjo, like Professor Mineta, and we just stopped at George Gaynos, he said you could play some banjo. They all talk about it, so I wish I could have heard you sometime. I never always think of you as a bass player. Which instrument do you really enjoy most, bass or banjo, guitar?
I'll tell you, I'll tell you. Player of that, maybe. I don't know why I didn't have a bass long years ago because I always did like the bass.
